name: plaza
description: Parametric plaza / town square (广场): full paving floor with pattern concentric (同心环带) / radial (8 放射辐条) / checker (棋盘) / border (只镶边), an accent rim (border_width), a reserved center accent disc (centerpiece=fountain/statue: 留位,用对应生成器建) or an inline flagpole (fence mast + concrete flag flying +x), and a rhythm of benches (stair seats facing outward = 坐者面向场心) and lamp posts (3 fence + lantern) along the inner rim. 两种形状: rect=规整矩形(城镇/前庭); circle=有机圆场(边缘按 seed 抖动±1 格, 外圈撒 dirt_path 磨损带)——树下/喷泉/神像等有机主体必用 circle。
when_to_use: Town squares, estate forecourts, market grounds, monument plinths. origin = min corner, y = floor layer (run terraform_pad first on rough terrain). Odd width/depth center best. centerpiece=fountain: run fountain.py with origin at the plaza center (origin y = plaza y, its basin rim rises one above the paving); centerpiece=statue: quadruped_statue.py on the disc.
use_for: 城镇广场/庄园前庭/集市/纪念碑基座;同心环带读纪念性,放射读巴洛克,棋盘读市集,镶边读街角小广场

pattern.notes: 同心环带/放射/棋盘/纯镶边

shape.notes: rect=城镇广场/建筑前庭;circle=有机圆场(边缘 seed 抖动±1+外圈 dirt_path 磨损带)——树下/喷泉/神像这类有机主体的广场必用, 孤立方垫子=实测翻车

seed.notes: circle 边缘抖动种子;换 seed 换边线

materials.notes: [主,次,强调];强调色要拉开明暗差(浅 quartz/深 blackstone 都常用)

centerpiece.notes: fountain/statue=只留强调色圆盘位;flagpole=脚本内建 6 高旗杆+双色旗

benches.notes: 内圈长椅(楼梯座,背朝外)

bench_material.notes: 石广场用 stone_brick_stairs 更耐看

lamps.notes: 灯柱(3 栅栏+灯笼),四角必有

lamp_material.notes: 灯柱杆;spruce_fence 深色,iron_bars 现代

pitfalls: 长椅楼梯 facing=背朝外(坐者面向场心),脚本按边推导;手改朝向长椅就背对广场
centerpiece=fountain/statue 只铺强调色圆盘留位——喷泉/雕像本体必须跑对应生成器,origin 对准广场中心 (ox+width//2, oy, oz+depth//2)
flagpole 的旗朝 +x 飘:x 轴镜像对称检查会挂,是单向设计不是 bug;要对称就别用 flagpole
放射图案的辐条占住中轴线,长椅自动让位;别再往轴线上摆东西,那是走进场心的视觉通道
棋盘格只用前两个材质,第三个材质仍是镶边/中心盘的强调色,别以为它没参与
偶数宽度中心缝在格线上,同心环带会偏半格——纪念性广场用奇数
广场是单层铺装,贴地形先 terraform_pad;直接铺在坡上就是悬浮地板
example: python patterns/plaza.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,100],"width":15,"depth":15,"pattern":"concentric","centerpiece":"fountain"}' --out plaza.json && python patterns/plaza.py --params '{"origin":[140,64,100],"width":21,"depth":21,"pattern":"radial","materials":["minecraft:polished_blackstone","minecraft:polished_deepslate","minecraft:quartz_block"],"centerpiece":"flagpole"}' --out plaza2.json
